entries.subject: DAMIT 4328: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: DAMIT model 4328, version 2019-05-07, pole (293°, -48°), period 15.97894 h, taken unchanged from the archive.

entries.subject: Physical scale
entries.finding: 112.32 ± 1.85 km, effective diameter of a sphere fitted to thermal infrared measurements. JPL lists a diameter of 112.32 ± 1.85 km, from NEOWISE (Grav et al. 2012, ApJ 759, 49; PDS bundle neowise_diameters_albedos 2.0). The thermal sphere diameter is transferred to the mesh as its volume-equivalent diameter.

entries.subject: Nestor whole-disc color
entries.finding: Gaia Collaboration, Galluccio et al. (2023) published the mean of 49 Gaia epoch spectra of the unresolved disc: reflectance against the Sun in 16 bands from 374 to 1034 nm, 1 at 550 nm (0.918 at 462 nm, 1.000 at 638 nm). The shape is painted in that one color (#353432 in sRGB) through the shared disc-integrated-color method, scaled to the 3.5% geometric albedo JPL lists (± 0.8%), from NEOWISE (Grav et al. 2012, ApJ 759, 49; PDS bundle neowise_diameters_albedos 2.0). It is one mean, not a map. Tinaut-Ruano et al. (2023), A&A 669, L14, found Gaia DR3 reflectances slightly too red at wavelengths shorter than 550 nm; the bands are used as published, without that paper's correction.
